description: This file defines the SignatureProvider class in the AWS SDK for PHP, responsible for providing and resolving signature objects used in request authentication. It includes methods for default provider creation, memoization, and handling various signature versions.

classes.name: SignatureProvider
classes.description: A class providing functions to resolve, create, and cache different request signature objects based on version, service, and region.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and returns a signature provider for given version, service, and region, throwing an exception if unable.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Returns the default signature provider with memoization.

methods.name: memoize
methods.description: Wraps a signature provider to cache its results based on version, service, and region.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Creates signature objects based on recognized signature versions (e.g., v4, v4a, v4-unsigned-body, bearer, anonymous).
